hero.title: Discover the Heritage of Karnataka
hero.subtitle: From Vijayanagara stone chariots and Hoysala soapstone temples to Yakshagana theatre, Mysore Dasara, and GI-protected crafts—explore every district's living cultural history.

map.sectionDesc: Hover over any district boundary or monument photo marker to preview its signature landmark, or click to explore verified cultural history.
map.searchPlaceholder: Search district or monument (e.g. Mysuru, Hampi, Hassan)...
map.selectPromptBody: Click any monument photograph or district boundary to view historical descriptions, cultural significance, gallery photographs, and verified archive links.

home.curatorialTitle: A living archive connecting built stone heritage with regional traditions.
home.curatorialBody: Karnataka holds an extraordinary cultural continuum—from Early Chalukyan sandstone shrines at Badami and Hoysala soapstone temples at Belur to Vijayanagara ruins at Hampi, coastal Yakshagana theatre, and GI-protected crafts.
home.aboutTitle: Stewarding open cultural knowledge across every region of Karnataka.
home.aboutBody: HeritageHub integrates authentic open GIS district boundaries with verified monographs, GI registry records, and multilingual community journalism.

culture.title: Cultural Heritage of Karnataka
culture.subtitle: Browse verified festivals, performing arts, historical monuments, regional cuisine, GI handicrafts, and community articles across all 31 districts.
culture.englishFallbackNote: Verified translation unavailable — displayed in English
culture.unavailableBody: No verified records match your active filter. HeritageHub does not publish unverified placeholder traditions.

auth.portalSubtitle: Select your role to sign in or create an account. Personal email addresses (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo) are welcome.
auth.initialAdminDesc: No administrator account exists yet in the local database. Complete this one-time setup to provision the founding HeritageHub administrator.
auth.roleUserDesc: Save favorite monuments & districts, track recent places, and sync your language preference.
auth.roleJournalistDesc: Draft, photograph, and submit district cultural articles for editorial review and publication.
auth.roleAdminDesc: Moderate accounts, review journalist submissions, and manage verified monuments and categories.
auth.bioPlaceholder: Describe your cultural journalism, research, or regional heritage focus...
auth.customQuestionPlaceholder: Or type your own custom security question...
auth.adminControlledNote: New administrator accounts are provisioned exclusively by an authenticated administrator after initial setup.

recovery.title: Reset Password via Security Question
recovery.step1Desc: Enter your registered email address to retrieve your security question.
recovery.step2Desc: Answer your registered security question to verify ownership.
recovery.step3Desc: Create a strong new password. All existing active sessions will be invalidated.

footer.tagline: Discover Karnataka. Preserve its Heritage. A source-verified digital cultural archive and interactive 31-district atlas documenting Karnataka's monuments, festivals, living arts, and culinary traditions.
